title: Rosemary Beach: Coco Cabana in Seacrest Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Coco Cabana in Seacrest Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Sunset Beach, and pool access at the large Lagoon Pool. Beach service chairs can be rented through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Enjoy a relaxing beach vacation at Coco Cabana! Only a leisurely stroll from the beach, Coco Cabana is centrally located in the Seacrest Beach Community nearby Rosemary Beach, FL along Scenic Highway 30A. Featuring a 12,000 square foot community pool and spacious parking, this home is sure to provide you with the total dream vacation experience! This 30A vacation home was recently updated with new appliances, a fresh coat of paint, and new coastal decor. You are in for a luxurious getaway when you choose Coco Cabana as your accommodations.

You'll know you're home when you approach the property and see carefully manicured Florida palms and lush local flora. The landscaping is stunning, giving the rental a lush and tropical feel. It thoughtfully adds to the relaxing and luxurious ambiance without obscuring the views. Plenty of lounging area in addition to patio furniture on the front porch as you enter the home. During your stay, enjoy dining al fresco on the well-appointed front porch or enjoy a sunset cocktail or good book on the comfortable loungers on the spacious second-floor deck of Coco Cabana.

Enter the front door and be greeted by classic decor and bright natural light flowing through intelligently placed windows. Generous seating and a fully equipped kitchen will ensure you have everything needed for the perfect get-together with friends and family. On the first floor is also one of the guest bedrooms featuring a queen and shared bathroom.

The second floor is host to the primary bedroom in addition to two additional guest bedrooms. The primary bedroom features a luxurious primary bathroom featuring a whirlpool tub and double vanity. One guest bedroom features a bunk bed with a trundle bed and the other features a queen. Both guest rooms share a bathroom. The guest bathroom also received a recent remodel to further enhance your stay! Should you choose to barbecue, the back patio features a gas grill and patio furniture.

If you don't feel like spending each day along the white sandy beaches of 30A, visit the community pool! No matter how you choose to fill your stay with fun, the community offers a tram to help you get to and from the beach and pool. The tram stop is located just out your front door on the side of the home and it runs from March 1 thru October 31. We know you'll enjoy your stay in the luxurious Coco Cabana, so book today!

**This property requires a 7 night stay Saturday to Saturday during Spring Break & Summer
